content_of_post_to_answer: Why does the mind continue speaking even when the lips remain silent?
answer: The mind keeps speaking because inner speech is not just a quieter version of talking; it is one of the ways the brain organizes experience. Before words reach the lips, the mind uses language to predict, rehearse, judge, remember, and make sense of what is happening. The interesting distinction is that silence outside does not mean silence inside. Sometimes the loudest conversations are the ones we never say aloud.
